senses.gloss:
चोद, अस्, m., Ved. an implement for driving
horses, a goad or whip; (अस्, आ, अम्), animating,
inspiring, promoting.
—चोद-प्रवृद्ध, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. exalted by the inspiring (draught of Soma),
an epithet of Indra.
चोद चोद, चोद्य. See चुद्, p. 327, col. 3.

चोदक, अस्, आ, अम्, driving; (अस्), m. direction,
invitation; (in grammar) = परि-ग्रह, q. v.

चोदन, अस्, आ, अम्, driving, impelling; (अम्), n.
the act of driving, inviting, invitation, order, rule,
precept; (आ), f. sending, commanding, directing; cast-
ing, throwing; enjoining, ordaining; a precept, sacred
ordinance or commandment; (ई), f., N. of a plant,
(a various reading for रोदनी); [cf. एक-चोदन.]
—चोदना-गुड, अस्, m. a ball for playing with.

चोदयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, impelling, animating, in-
spiring.
—चोदयन्-मति (˚यत्-म˚), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved.
[]
inspiring, promoting piety or devotion; (Sāy.) whose
mind is inspiring.

चोदयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, driving, impelling, ani-
mating, promoting.
चोदस्, अस्, n. = चोदन. See अ-चोदस्.

चोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, urged; ordered,
directed; thrown, cast; appointed; informed, ap-
prised.

चोदितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, driving, impelling, animating,
promoting.

चोदिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of preceding), Ved.
impelling or animating much.

चोद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be driven or impelled; to be
sent, thrown or directed; to be mentioned or com-
municated; (अम्), n. raising a question, objecting,
asking a question; surprise, astonishment, wonder.
चोद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being urged or driven.
